Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great questions from the ML infra team. Per our conversation, I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) and an initial billing/runbook layout for the GCP private offer so procurement can see the milestones and acceptance gates.

High-level MAP (attached LYNX_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Week 0 (Contracting): Finalize PO terms and private-offer SKU mapping (Procurement + Redwood Legal)
- Week 1 (Sandbox): Grant eval access to two test projects; Redwood provides support window and baseline perf tests
- Week 2–3 (Eval): Customer runs production-like load; we collect perf and cost metrics, provide tuning recommendations
- Week 4 (Acceptance): Technical acceptance signoff (Laura to coordinate), billing activation and invoice routing confirmed

Proposed next steps:
1) Procurement to confirm required PO fields and billing contact.
2) We’ll drop in a revised MAP (v2) that tracks legal redlines and DocuSign milestones.
3) Schedule a 30-min procurement walkthrough with your billing team — would Thu 11/19 11am PT work?

Attachments: LYNX_MAP_v1.xlsx, LYNX_SOW_draft.docx

Cheers,

Adding a few notes for the procurement call and what we should have prepared:

1) Marketplace private-offer mechanics (GCP):
   - We can publish a private offer tied to LynxHealth's billing account. Private offer will include SKU rates and effective dates.
   - GCP supports invoice-level PO numbers; however, the PO field must match the invoice metadata we provide.

2) Billing options to present:
   - Option A: Consolidated monthly invoice to a single billing contact (recommended for smaller finance teams).
   - Option B: Split invoicing by project/GL (requires setting up invoice bundling rules; extra config time ~1–2 weeks).

3) Acceptance & activation sequence:
   - Legal signs private offer via DocuSign (we provide the link) -> GCP processes private offer -> Redwood provisions accounts -> Onboarding activation and first invoice.

4) Attachables for call: sample invoice (I’ll attach), SOC2_summary.pdf (security), and a one-pager that maps our private-offer fields to GCP invoice fields.

I’ll join the Thu 11/19 call — Soojin, can you confirm we’ll send LYNX_MAP_v2 with updated milestones and a DocuSign target date?

— Aditya
